status: posthoc localization on already inspected Dev, not fresh confirmation

factorial.endpoint: Each object independently uses its original t6 or t7 pose; first frame fixed at mask000
factorial.labels: Actual composite positions and displacement from original t6; labels never enter encoder or frozen reader

extraction.canonical_pool: unchanged4x4 FP32 average followed by BF16 rounding and FP32 storage
extraction.extra: prequant FP32 pooled features for all masks; same-call pre-storage FP32 raw tokens only for original000/111 cues
extraction.encoder_forward: Existing frozen official I-JEPA target_encoder, BF16 autocast; FP32 outputs are not full-FP32 inference

original_parity.failure: Retain all outputs; do not interpret new interventions as matched to original W if parity fails

analyses: last pooled BF16 rounding sensitivity on original cues

lane_reader.features: same existing4x4features;1280channels per cell, no oracle masks
lane_reader.training: same W4096views, common masked N+W8192reference, quadratic kernel, free intercept
lane_reader.limitations: Masked kernel geometry changes; tokens remain globally contextual and both halves can contain yellow

precision_analysis.raw_delta_projection: Mean-pool16x16 to4x4 and repeat to16x16; retained squared norm of original cue difference is feature-change energy, not motion information

budget.retry: No automatic scientific rerun; preserve failure scene

boundaries.shapley: Interventions attribute response to changed scene components, not causal responsibility to neural modules
boundaries.new_reader: Diagnostic on known Dev; any subsequent pass claim needs independent confirmation
